reason: For 8 boys that is about 1,600 rupees every month, and right now my technicians just send me a WhatsApp voice note and a photo of the old part for free. I might let them set up the free month, but I am not going to start paying a monthly bill for something I can mostly do with WhatsApp.
objection: Will it really understand my boys speaking Tamil and Tanglish on a noisy rooftop with the outdoor unit running, or will I end up fixing the reports myself? And after the free month it is one more bill that grows every time I hire someone.
would_change_my_mind: If in the free month it actually settles a customer dispute about which part was changed, and the price is a flat amount for my whole shop of around 500 rupees a month instead of per technician.
